mapper.select: SELECT C.FNUMBER FROM T_BD_SYSTEMSTATUSCTROL A INNER JOIN T_BD_SYSTEMSTATUS B ON A.FSYSTEMSTATUSID = B.FID INNER JOIN T_BD_PERIOD C ON A.FCURRENTPERIODID = C.FID INNER JOIN T_ORG_BASEUNIT D ON A.FCOMPANYID = D.FID WHERE B.FNAME = '6' AND D.FNUMBER = #{orgId}
SELECT fid AS eas_fid, FNUMBER AS code, FNAME_L2 AS name FROM HXORACLE.t_bd_person
SELECT fid AS eas_fid, FNUMBER AS code, FNAME_L2 AS name FROM HXORACLE.T_BD_Bank
SELECT fid AS eas_fid, FNUMBER AS code, FNAME_L2 AS name FROM HXORACLE.T_ORG_COSTCENTER
SELECT t.fid AS eas_fid, t.FNUMBER AS code, t.FNAME_L2 AS name, g.FNAME_L2 AS asst_type FROM HXORACLE.T_BD_GeneralAsstActType t JOIN T_BD_GeneralAsstActTypeGroup g ON t.FGROUPID = g.FID
SELECT t.fid AS eas_fid, t.FNUMBER AS code, t.FNAME_L2 AS name, '合同号' AS asst_type FROM HXORACLE.T_BD_MATERIAL t

SELECT C.FNUMBER orgId, P.FNUMBER periodCode FROM T_BD_SYSTEMSTATUSCTROL A LEFT JOIN T_BD_SYSTEMSTATUS B ON A.FSYSTEMSTATUSID = B.FID LEFT JOIN T_BD_PERIOD P ON A.FCURRENTPERIODID = P.FID LEFT JOIN T_ORG_COMPANY C ON A.FCOMPANYID = C.FID WHERE B.FNAME = 6

select 'NOT_EXECUTE' "messageStatus", gv.FID "fid", gv.FABSTRACT "abstractContent", toc.FNUMBER "orgId", toc.FNAME_L2 "orgName", tbp.FNUMBER "periodCode", tbm.fnumber "contractCode", tbm.FNAME_L2 "contractName", tbc1.FNUMBER "clientCode" , tbc1.FNAME_L2 "clientName", gav.FASSGRPID "fassgrpId" , tbc.FNAME_L2 "currencyName" , gac.FNUMBER "accountCode", gac.FNAME_L2 "accountName", nullif(DECODE(GE.FENTRYDC, '1', coalesce(GAV.FLOCALAMOUNT, GE.FLOCALAMOUNT), '0'), 0) "debitAmount", nullif(DECODE(GE.FENTRYDC, '0', coalesce(GAV.FLOCALAMOUNT, GE.FLOCALAMOUNT), '0'), 0) "creditAmount" from HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHER GV inner join HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc on toc.FID = gv.FCOMPANYID inner join HXORACLE.T_BD_PERIOD TBP on TBP.FID = gv.FPERIODID inner join HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHERENTRY GE on GV.FID = GE.FBILLID inner join HXORACLE.T_BD_CURRENCY tbc on GE.FCURRENCYID = tbc.FID left join HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHERASSISTRECORD GAV on GE.FID = GAV.FENTRYID left join HXORACLE.T_BD_ASSISTANTHG HG on HG.FID = GAV.FASSGRPID inner join HXORACLE.T_BD_ACCOUNTVIEW GAC on GE.FACCOUNTID = GAC.FID left outer join HXORACLE.T_BD_MATERIAL tbm on HG.FMATERIALID = TBM.FID left outer join HXORACLE.T_BD_CUSTOMER tbc1 on HG.FCUSTOMERID = TBC1.FID where gv.fid in ( select gv1.fid from HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHER GV1 inner join HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHERENTRY GE1 on GV1.FID = GE1.FBILLID inner join HXORACLE.T_BD_ACCOUNTVIEW GAC1 on GE1.FACCOUNTID = GAC1.FID where gv1.fid in ( select gv2.fid fid from HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHER GV2 inner join HXORACLE.T_ORG_COMPANY toc2 on toc2.FID = gv2.FCOMPANYID inner join HXORACLE.T_BD_PERIOD TBP2 on TBP2.FID = gv2.FPERIODID inner join HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHERENTRY GE2 on GV2.FID = GE2.FBILLID left outer join HXORACLE.T_GL_VOUCHERASSISTRECORD GAV2 on GE2.FID = GAV2.FENTRYID left outer join HXORACLE.T_BD_ASSISTANTHG HG2 on HG2.FID = GAV2.FASSGRPID left outer join HXORACLE.T_BD_MATERIAL tbm2 on HG2.FMATERIALID = TBM2.FID where gv2.FBIZSTATUS = 5 and tbp2.FNUMBER = #{periodCode} and gv2.fbookeddate = to_date(#{voucherDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') and toc2.fnumber in ('01-C0001', '02-C0002', '30001', '80001') and tbm2.fnumber like 'KCB%' and gac1.fnumber='1531.02' ))
